subject: Mathematics
topic: Number systems, ratios, rates and financial maths
topicAf: Getallestelsels, verhoudings, tempo en finansiële wiskunde

items.q: Which of these is an irrational number?
items.qAf: Watter een van hierdie is ’n irrasionale getal?
items.explain: √2 cannot be written as a fraction, so it is irrational. √9 = 3, 0,75 = 3/4 and 22/7 are rational.
items.explainAf: √2 kan nie as ’n breuk geskryf word nie, dus is dit irrasionaal. √9 = 3, 0,75 = 3/4 en 22/7 is rasionaal.

items.q: Between which two whole numbers does √30 lie?
items.explain: 5² = 25 and 6² = 36, and 25 < 30 < 36, so √30 lies between 5 and 6.
items.explainAf: 5² = 25 en 6² = 36, en 25 < 30 < 36, dus lê √30 tussen 5 en 6.

items.q: Divide R360 in the ratio 3 : 5 : 4. How much is the smallest share?
items.qAf: Verdeel R360 in die verhouding 3 : 5 : 4. Hoeveel is die kleinste deel?
items.explain: There are 12 parts, so R360 ÷ 12 = R30 per part. The smallest share is 3 × R30 = R90.
items.explainAf: Daar is 12 dele, dus R360 ÷ 12 = R30 per deel. Die kleinste deel is 3 × R30 = R90.

items.q: R5 000 is invested at 6% simple interest per year. How much interest is earned in 3 years?
items.qAf: R5 000 word belê teen 6% enkelvoudige rente per jaar. Hoeveel rente word in 3 jaar verdien?

items.q: A phone costs R8 400 and is discounted by 15%. What is the sale price?
items.qAf: ’n Foon kos R8 400 en word met 15% verlaag. Wat is die verkoopprys?
items.explain: 15% of R8 400 is R1 260, so the sale price is R8 400 − R1 260 = R7 140.
items.explainAf: 15% van R8 400 is R1 260, dus is die verkoopprys R8 400 − R1 260 = R7 140.

items.q: Numbers that can be written as a fraction a/b of integers (b ≠ 0).
items.qAf: Getalle wat as ’n breuk a/b van heelgetalle geskryf kan word (b ≠ 0).

items.q: Numbers that cannot be written as a fraction of integers, such as √2 and π.
items.qAf: Getalle wat nie as ’n breuk van heelgetalle geskryf kan word nie, soos √2 en π.

items.q: Interest calculated on the original amount plus the interest already earned.
items.qAf: Rente wat op die oorspronklike bedrag plus die rente wat reeds verdien is, bereken word.

items.q: A situation in which one quantity increases as the other decreases at the same rate (xy = k).
items.qAf: ’n Situasie waarin een hoeveelheid toeneem soos die ander teen dieselfde tempo afneem (xy = k).

items.q: If 4 workers take 6 days to build a wall, 8 workers will take 3 days (at the same rate).
items.qAf: As 4 werkers 6 dae neem om ’n muur te bou, sal 8 werkers 3 dae neem (teen dieselfde tempo).

items.q: Calculate the final amount if R5 000 is invested at 10% compound interest per year for 2 years, in rand.
items.qAf: Bereken die finale bedrag as R5 000 vir 2 jaar teen 10% saamgestelde rente per jaar belê word, in rand.
